selected.assay: bulk RNA-seq (TruSeq stranded mRNA, NovaSeq 6000), gastrocnemius muscle (S4.13.p1)

exercise: 60 min acute treadmill run at 16 m/min

selected.sample_inclusion: 64 libraries, 8 per genotype x ZT x exercise cell (4F/4M); one sample excluded for low coverage (group HIF1a-mKO, exercise, ZT3) (S4.14.p1); tissue collected immediately after the 60 min bout (S1.6.p1)
selected.primary_estimand: How HIF1a loss and time of day modify the skeletal muscle transcriptional response to acute exercise: KO vs fl/fl within exercised (and sedentary) mice at ZT3 and ZT15, and ZT15 vs ZT3 within each genotype x exercise state (S1.6.p1-p2, Fig. 5)
planned_contrasts: KO vs fl/fl, exercised, ZT3 (S1.6.p2; paper: 516 DEGs)
KO vs fl/fl, exercised, ZT15 (S1.6.p2; paper: 91 DEGs)
KO vs fl/fl, sedentary, ZT3 and ZT15 (S1.6.p2, Fig. 5D; counts only in figure, 'similar profiles')
ZT15 vs ZT3 within fl/fl sedentary (451), fl/fl exercise (273), KO sedentary (101), KO exercise (191) (S1.6.p1)
KO vs fl/fl overall (724 up / 749 down = 1473) (S1.6.p1, SI Fig. S7A; exact contrast not stated)
selected.repeated_measure_unit: none: one gastrocnemius per animal, independent animals
selected.normalization: DESeq2 size factors; independent filtering on mean of normalized counts (20,224 genes passed) (S4.14.p1)
selected.paper_method: DESeq2 negative binomial GLM, design ~ 0 + group + sex (S4.14.p1)
selected.paper_results: Exercise ZT3 KO vs fl/fl 516, ZT15 91; ZT15 vs ZT3: fl/fl sed 451, fl/fl ex 273, KO sed 101, KO ex 191; KO vs fl/fl overall 724 up / 749 down; GSEA GO: oxidative phosphorylation / respiration positively enriched in KO vs fl/fl after exercise at ZT3 not ZT15; Mpi elevated in KO (Fig. 4G)
selected.not_reported: The paper reports no direct exercise vs sedentary DEG counts.

decisions.reason: Methods S4.14.p1 give DESeq2 with ~0 + group + sex and FDR alpha 0.1, no fold-change rule; S1.6.p1-p2 give the contrasts and counts. Group = genotype x ZT x exercise cell. The paper's exercise-related estimands are genotype and time-of-day differences within exercise state; exercise vs sedentary contrasts are not reported and will run exploratory from the same model.

checks: GEO: gastrocnemius, Mus musculus, HIF1a KO/WT, ZT3/ZT15, ex/sed, 60 min treadmill 16 m/min - matches S4.3.p1
64 samples = 2 x 2 x 2 x 8, 4F/4M per cell, matching 'male and female mice utilized equally' (S4.2.p1)
data_processing: STAR mm10 + featureCounts, as S4.14.p1

decisions.reason: Accession, tissue, factors, and processing match the paper.

excluded_samples.GSM8647977: library 0156_44 (ko_3_ex_44) has 382 total reads vs median 16 M; the paper excluded one KO exercise ZT3 sample for low coverage (S4.14.p1) - this is it

decisions.reason: Matrix columns are library names (0156_N) that sit in the metadata description field 'Library name: 0156_N'; exact match after extraction (64/64). Factor columns derived from GEO characteristics (genotype, zt, treatment, Sex).

candidates: raw_counts (confirm against provenance: normalized integers and rounded estimated counts look the same)

decisions.reason: All values integer, max 6.6e6, median 0; GEO data_processing says 'text file with raw counts per sample' from featureCounts; paper fits DESeq2 on these counts.

selected.formula: ~ sex + cell(geno x zt x trt)
selected.exploratory: exercise vs sedentary within each genotype x ZT cell and the 2x2 interactions, from the same model (not reported in the paper)

decisions.reason: Paper's DESeq2 design is ~0 + group + sex with group = genotype x ZT x exercise (S4.14.p1); its reported DEG sets are simple effects between cells (S1.6.p1-p2). One cell-means model on all 63 retained samples with sex covariate reproduces this. Exercise vs sedentary simple effects run exploratory.

covariates.name: sex
covariates.disposition: included as additive covariate, as in the paper's ~0 + group + sex (S4.14.p1)

decisions.reason: Independent animals (one muscle each), no repeated measures. Sex is balanced 4F/4M within each cell (3F/4M in KO ZT3 EX after exclusion or 4F/3M), so not confounded; the paper includes it as covariate. No batch or cage variable recorded in GEO; none added.

deviations: pydeseq2 rather than R DESeq2; independent filtering applied by pydeseq2 with alpha 0.1

decisions.reason: Raw featureCounts counts support DESeq2; the cell-means joint model with sex covariate is the paper's parameterization.
S4.14.p1: P-values FDR-corrected and alpha set to 0.1; no fold-change cutoff stated. Audit at padj < 0.05 for comparability with workflow default.
One DESeq2 cell-means model ~ sex + cell on all 63 samples (paper's ~0 + group + sex); planned contrasts are the paper's, the exercise vs sedentary and interaction contrasts are exploratory.
Additive genotype main effect ~ sex + zt + trt + geno to approximate the paper's overall KO vs fl/fl count (contrast unstated in the paper).
